document.about: Hydrology and Earth System Sciences 28, 781 (2024), set in two columns. On p5, Table 1 runs the page's full width over the two columns of prose, ruled between its rows; its columns part where the prose's gutter runs.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#408): the reading across the gutter was cut there, so the table's last two columns became loose paragraphs. A reading ruled through the gutter is now one table.

checks.issue: #408: Table 1 was cut at the page's gutter, and its Temporal resolution cells came out as paragraphs.
